title: DC Comics Essential Graphic Novels 2016 Catalog Ivan Reis Cover Batman Superman
conditionDescription: Clean and bright with light handling wear. See photo.
descriptionText:
DC Comics Essential Graphic Novels No. 1 (2016) - DC Entertainment's catalog and reading guide to its essential graphic novels. Cover by Ivan Reis with Batman, Superman, the Joker, Doomsday, Lex Luthor and more.

Condition: clean and bright with light handling wear (see photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
